description.vi: Bộ khởi đầu cho đội CSKH: hai Soot tiếp nhận và xử lý chuyên sâu, chuyển cho thành viên khi cần, cùng các kỹ năng chung không gắn với sản phẩm nào.
description.en: A starter for a customer care team: triage and escalation Soots that hand off to members, with generic skills tied to no product.

skills.name: cs-triage
skills.description: Sort each customer message: check price, plan and account facts with the product tool, answer how-to questions from the collection, ask one question, hand off, or decline.

skills.name: handoff-policy
skills.description: When and how to hand a case to a team member with report_blocker, what to tell the customer, and how to resume after a member replies.

skills.name: tone
skills.description: How a customer care Soot sounds: short, warm, plain, in the customer's language, never promising what it cannot show.

skills.name: person-memory
skills.description: What to remember about a returning person, what never to keep, and how to recall and forget it.

label.vi: Cuộc trò chuyện đã giải quyết
